basis_parity_tolerance: Inherited rotation orthogonality max_abs threshold=1e-4; functional-basis relative L2 uses frozen historical IDENTITY_TOL=1e-6; no relaxed tolerance.

candidate_definition.HISTORICAL_J_PROP: Call unchanged inherited replay_step; support 1024..anchor; mean over tokens then 18 layers
candidate_definition.J_INJ: Same historical replay_step index1; support 1024..anchor; mean over tokens then 18 layers
candidate_definition.LOCAL_K3_ACCUMULATED: historical query_readout(E_anchor,prepared_query_at_anchor); FP32 then FP64 squared norm
candidate_definition.POR: sum_future squared norm of FP32 historical K3_readout(pulse)-K3_readout(ref), FP64 reduction
candidate_definition.POR_GAIN: POR/RAW_ACC_ERROR; epsilon=0; exactly zero denominator returns 0
candidate_definition.PULSE_PROP_ENERGY_AUC: sum_future squared Frobenius norm of two-path FP32 state difference, FP64 reduction

decision_rule.MIXED: not PRESENT AND median delta_rho>0; inconsistent Spearman/concordance or document consistency
decision_rule.PRESENT: rho POR>PROP in >=3/4 docs AND median delta_rho>0 AND concordance POR>PROP in >=3/4 docs AND median rho_POR>0

endpoint_32K: RAW_ACC_ERROR and LOCAL_K3_ACCUMULATED only, plus historical J_INJ/J_PROP/J_ACC; no future POR
future_support: anchor+1 through 32768 inclusive; token index is one-based count of consumed teacher-forced tokens
historical_JPROP_parity: Unchanged replay_step vs independent import; bitwise compare all four states and all five fields on same 32-token development trace.
model_checkpoint: Ling-3.0-tiny official revision e3a47d5b986e7141b6efd62597d598ebb392060d; exact inherited SHA inventory

primary_target.auc: streaming FP64 sum of historical per-token FP32 scalar; no averaging across future tokens; no negative-value clamping
primary_target.model_path: natural full-model teacher-forced FP; only actual accumulated KDA cache state pulse at anchor
primary_target.name: FUTURE_FULL_LOGIT_KL_AUC

ranking.implementation: inherited stats.spearman/stats.order; exact ties, no added tolerance
ranking.top_bottom: set intersection fraction of exact tied minimum/maximum sets, divided by union size
